note: Large forested area along the North Fabius River north of Lewistown. This entry is the primitive camping in the north tract: camping spots beside small gravel lots along the county roads, marked on the area map as A (end of Road 369), B (Road 369 / 152nd Avenue, this pin), C (Road 356 / Cherry Street, west) and D (Cherry Street at Chestnut Avenue). No amenities; quiet hours 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. Spot length is not published. The lake camp, the horse camp and the main tract's camps are their own entry. --Claude
summary: North-tract camping confirmed: area page 'Designated Camping Sites, Individual Campsites'; brochure 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas... No amenities are provided... 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period'. Map (8/1/2023) shows camps A, B, C on Roads 369/356 and D at Cherry St/Chestnut Ave, each with a P lot; horse camp is in the main tract 3+ km away. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights written manual. Pin (GIS 311) is in a crop field 48 m W of camp B's gravel lot: move to 40.2146,-91.8546. Phone matches. Not waterfront kept.
flags: PIN (minor, 48 m): stored 40.21445,-91.85506 = GIS camping point 311, which on imagery sits in a crop field ~48 m west of camp B's gravel lot (GIS lot 2067, a ~25 x 20 m gravel pad on the east side of Road 369 / 152nd Ave). Suggest 40.2146,-91.8546, on the lot.

INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Camping: Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack(no Deer/Turkey), Designated Camping Sites, Individual Campsites'. Brochure (2024): 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas. These may or may not have defined campsites. Seasonal closures and restrictions may apply. No unattended open campfires allowed. No amenities are provided... Stays are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period. Quiet hours are from 10:00 p.m. to 6 a.m.' Map: camping symbols with a P at A, B, C and D. Imagery: B = gravel pad on the county road; A (GIS 348) = grassy opening beside a gravel lot (2908) at the end of the road, point at the tree line ~65 m E of the lot; C (GIS 347) = gravel loop/lot (2909) with the camping point in a grassy clearing ~60 m N of it. All reached on gravel county roads; a 23-ft rig fits the lots. No ford, 4WD or rig wording.

HORSE CAMP: the area page's 'Horse campground' (tie-ups, restrooms, trailer parking, trail access) is in the main tract among the trail loops (p3-334 identified camp F, 40.1944,-91.8209); the north-tract camps are 2-3.5 km away on county roads, plainly separate.

CLUSTERS: A 40.2183,-91.8492 (GIS 348, 0.65 km NE of B), B 40.2145,-91.8551 (pin), C 40.2080,-91.8636 (GIS 347, 1.0 km SW), D 40.2080,-91.8372 (GIS 312 / lot 2068, 1.7 km ESE, at the Cherry St / Chestnut Ave junction). D is on the map along county road 356 like the others but neither entry's note named it (1932's note covers the lake and main tract); the proposed note lists it here. No further split: all four sit on the same county roads within 1.7 km.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): B is in fields away from any water; the nearest water is Cooper Branch wetlands ~0.5 km SE of D.
Note: camp D added, 'no hookups or water' replaced by the brochure's 'No amenities', quiet hours kept, horse camp named as elsewhere.
